% A revtex4-1 article without hyperref, with a title, an abstract, and
% headings of each level. tex4ht has no revtex4-1.4ht either.
\documentclass{revtex4-1}
\begin{document}
\title{Revhead old title}
\author{Someone}
\begin{abstract}
Text of the old abstract.
\end{abstract}
\maketitle
\section{First section}\label{sec:first}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{A subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\subsubsection{A subsubsection}
Text of the subsubsection.
\paragraph{A paragraph.}
Text of the paragraph.
\section*{Starred section}
Text of the starred section, after section~\ref{sec:first}.
\section[Short]{Long title of a section}
Text of the long section.
\begin{acknowledgments}
Text of the acknowledgments.
\end{acknowledgments}
\end{document}
